We have no business being in NATO or in American wars.
France must build a worldwide front of non-aligned nations in favor of an orderly world.

NEW: Turkish President Erdogan held a phone call with Trump, discussing Türkiye-US bilateral ties and regional and global developments.
Erdogan said he believes cooperation between the two countries will keep growing and that Ankara will work to give relations more momentum. 
On Iran, he said the tension between Tehran and Washington must end and the issues be resolved through diplomacy, adding that Türkiye will keep working for peace. 
On the Ukraine-Russia war, he said he hopes the growing diplomatic efforts bring a positive result, that Türkiye will keep contributing, and that stepping up contacts with both Kyiv and Moscow is important. 
He also thanked Trump for supporting the Organization of Turkic States Summit.

French Presidential Candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon:
We will directly engage in resolving the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
Because we French, who have been invaded four times by our neighbor, will never agree with the idea that anyone should invade anyone else to resolve a political problem.
We do not accept the idea of peace involving territorial concessions in Ukraine without asking the populations concerned whether they agree to be on one side of the border or the other.
It is up to the people themselves to decide what they want.
